Note any unfinished work or open questions.\"\n\tpreInjectScreen, _ := ptyMgr.CaptureScreen(paneTarget)\n\tif err := ptyMgr.InjectPrompt(paneTarget, summaryPrompt); err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"inject prompt: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn ptyMgr.WaitForResponse(summCtx, paneTarget, preInjectScreen, nil)\n}\n\n// cmdPing handles /ping — measures round-trip latency to the proxy /health endpoint.\nfunc (h *CommandHandler) cmdPing(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {\n\tstart := time.Now()\n\treq, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, h.proxyURL+\"/health\", nil)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"build request: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tresp, err := h.client.Do(req)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"health check failed: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tresp.Body.Close()\n\tlatency := time.Since(start).Round(time.Millisecond)\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"pong (%s round-trip to proxy)\", latency), nil\n}\n\n// cmdVersion handles /version — shows version information for bridge, proxy, and contract.\nfunc (h *CommandHandler) cmdVersion(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {\n\t// Fetch proxy health info to get version and uptime\n\treq, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, h.proxyURL+\"/health\", nil)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"build request: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tresp, err := h.client.Do(req)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"proxy health request failed: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tdefer resp.Body.Close()\n\n\tvar proxyHealth contract.HealthResponse\n\tif err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&proxyHealth); path, enables WAL mode,\n357\t// and applies any pending migrations.\n358\tfunc OpenDB(path string) (*DB, error) {\n359\t\tdb, err := sql.Open(\"sqlite\", path)\n360\t\tif err != nil {\n361\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"open sqlite %q: %w\", path, err)\n362\t\t}\n363\t\n364\t\t// SQLite works best with a single writer connection.\n365\t\tdb.SetMaxOpenConns(1)\n366\t\n367\t\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;\"); err != nil {\n368\t\t\tdb.Close()\n369\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable WAL: %w\", err)\n370\t\t}\n371\t\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;\"); err != nil {\n372\t\t\tdb.Close()\n373\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable foreign keys: %w\", err)\n374\t\t}\n375\t\n376\t\td := &DB{db: db}\n377\t\tif err := d.migrate(); err != nil {\n378\t\t\tdb.Close()\n379\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"migrate: %w\", err)\n380\t\t}\n381\t\treturn d, nil\n382\t}\n383\t\n384\t// Close closes the underlying database connection.\n385\tfunc (d *DB) Close() error {\n386\t\treturn d.db.Close()\n387\t}\n388\t\n389\t// SqlDB returns the underlying *sql.DB for use with other packages.\n390\tfunc (d *DB) SqlDB() *sql.DB {\n391\t\treturn d.db\n392\t}\n393\t\n394\t// migrate creates the schema_version table if needed, then applies any\n395\t// migrations whose version number exceeds the current schema version.\n396\tfunc (d *DB) migrate() error {\n397\t\t_, err := d.db.Exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version (\n398\t\t\tversion    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n399\t\t\tapplied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n400\t\t);`)\n401\t\tif err != nil {\n402\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"create schema_version: %w\", err)\n403\t\t}\n404\t\n405\t\tvar current int\n406\t\trow := d.db.QueryRow(`SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_version`)\n407\t\tif err := row.Scan(&current); err != nil {\n408\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"read schema_version: %w\", err)\n409\t\t}\n410\t\n411\t\tfor i, ddl := range migrations {\n412\t\t\tversion := i + 1\n413\t\t\tif version <= current {\n414\t\t\t\tcontinue\n415\t\t\t}\n416\t\n417\t\t\ttx, err := d.db.Begin()\n418\t\t\tif err != nil {\n419\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"begin migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n420\t\t\t}\n421\t\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(ddl); err != nil {\n422\t\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n423\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"apply migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n424\t\t\t}\n425\t\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n426\t\t\t\t`INSERT INTO schema_version (version) VALUES (?)`, version,\n427\t\t\t); err != nil {\n428\t\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n429\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"record migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n430\t\t\t}\n431\t\t\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n432\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"commit migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n433\t\t\t}\n434\t\t}\n435\t\treturn nil\n436\t}\n437\t\n438\t// ── groups ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n439\t\n440\t// GetGroup returns the group with the {\n\t\tdb.Close()\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"migrate: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn d, nil\n}\n\n// Close closes the underlying database connection.\nfunc (d *DB) Close() error {\n\treturn d.db.Close()\n}\n\n// SqlDB returns the underlying *sql.DB for use with other packages.\nfunc (d *DB) SqlDB() *sql.DB {\n\treturn d.db\n}\n\n// migrate creates the schema_version table if needed, then applies any\n// migrations whose version number exceeds the current schema version.\nfunc (d *DB) migrate() error {\n\t_, err := d.db.Exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version (\n\t\tversion    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n\t\tapplied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n\t);`)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"create schema_version: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tvar current int\n\trow := d.db.QueryRow(`SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_version`)\n\tif err := row.Scan(&current); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"read schema_version: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tfor i, ddl := range migrations {\n\t\tversion := i + 1\n\t\tif version <= current {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\ttx, err := d.db.Begin()\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"begin migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(ddl); err != nil {\n\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"apply migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n\t\t\t`INSERT INTO schema_version (version) VALUES (?)`, version,\n\t\t); err != nil {\n\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"record migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"commit migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// ── groups tx.Commit()\n}\n\ntype groupScanner interface {\n\tScan(dest ...any) error\n}\n\nfunc scanGroup(s groupScanner) (*Group, error) {\n\tvar g Group\n\tvar createdAt string\n\terr := s.Scan(&g.ChatID,
